tldr: Mars in the 1st house routes drive and action through selfhood and embodiment.
body: With Mars in the 1st house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through identity, body, presence, and first response to life. This makes how you enter the room, claim space, and let the world meet you a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through selfhood and embodiment.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in selfhood and embodiment.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
